name: omp-whatsapp
description: WhatsApp bridge for omp (Baileys + omp --mode rpc)

omp.name: WhatsApp
omp.description: Chat with omp from WhatsApp; /whatsapp manages the bridge service

allowedNumbers.description: WhatsApp numbers allowed to command the agent, comma-separated, international format without + (e.g. 628123456789)

cwd.description: Default project directory; changing it switches the bridge there with a fresh session (/cd does the same from WhatsApp). Empty = home

model.description: Model override as provider/id, e.g. anthropic/claude-sonnet-5 (empty = your omp default role)

progress.description: Show a "typing…" indicator while the agent works. WhatsApp cannot live-edit a sent message, so no progress messages are sent

notifications.description: Send status and final answer when main-agent work in the omp terminal finishes (excludes WhatsApp, RPC, print/JSON, and subagents)
